---
name: Permission request
about: Ask the owner for permission to use AIPS beyond evaluation (copy, modify, pilot, integrate, publish, license)
title: "Permission request: <what you want to do>"
labels: permission-request
---

**Who you are**
Name, role, and organisation.

**What you want to do**
For example: run a pilot on our infrastructure, integrate part of AIPS, modify it, publish benchmark results,
obtain a commercial licence, or collaborate.

**Which parts of AIPS**
Whole system, or specific modules or documents.

**Scope and duration**
Environments, number of systems, start and end dates.

**Anything else the owner should know**

---
By opening this request you confirm that you have not copied, modified or used AIPS beyond evaluation, and
that you will not do so unless the owner grants written permission in reply.
